evidence: Synthetic closed-loop traces; FAST-LIO/NDT was not executed; no obstacles in this analysis.
primary_endpoint: Per-trial turn lateral_rmse_m, descriptive paired comparison of full versus native.

timing.state: Raw state and error are post-step at t; first observed state is t=0.05 s.
timing.command: cmd_v/cmd_w on row i were issued at t[i]-dt and held for the next control interval.
timing.initial_missing: No t=0 state sample is inserted. Time integrals omit [0, first_t]. Missing interval is reported.
timing.derivative: First differences are evaluated at interval midpoints; second differences at means of consecutive midpoints. Exported on the right endpoint row with explicit evaluation times.

phases.rule: Geometry only; curvature k=gradient(unwrapped path yaw, path arc length), dk=gradient(k,s), interpolated at measured true path progress.
phases.channel_alignment: A phase row groups state endpoint samples at t and the command that produced that interval, issued at t-dt. Command phase bins therefore follow the resulting state interval, not an invented command-time state. Lag analysis separately uses the exact command issue clock.
phases.caveat: On the unsmoothed historical polyline, derivative-defined phases can alternate rapidly; these are geometric bins, not independently observed steering events.

errors.rmse: sqrt(mean(e_i^2)); sample weighted, one statistic per trial/phase.
errors.sd: Sample standard deviation, ddof=1; undefined for fewer than 2 observations.
errors.p95_abs: 95th percentile abs(e), NumPy linear quantile interpolation.
errors.iae: sum of trapezoids of abs(e) dt, observed contiguous intervals only.
errors.itae: sum of trapezoids of t*abs(e) dt; t is mission time from actual experiment origin 0. Phase ITAE uses the same mission origin, not a reset clock.
errors.ise: sum of trapezoids of e^2 dt
errors.distance_rmse: sqrt(sum(0.5*(e_i^2+e_(i+1)^2)*ds_i)/sum(ds_i)); ds is Euclidean displacement between adjacent true x,y samples.
errors.distance_mae: Trapezoidal abs(e) weighted by the same true Euclidean displacement.
errors.phase_integration: Both adjacent endpoints must belong to the phase, and 0<dt<=1.5*nominal_dt. Never concatenate separated phase segments. Boundary fragments are omitted explicitly.

smoothness.separation: cmd channels describe requested commands; body channels describe simulated executed velocities after smoothing, delay and first-order dynamics.
smoothness.delta_rms: RMS of adjacent velocity increments; no inferred pre-first-command jump.
smoothness.total_variation: sum(abs(delta velocity)) across valid, contiguous selected intervals.
smoothness.rate_or_accel: First finite difference delta velocity/delta time. cmd uses rate; body uses accel. RMS, P95 abs and max abs supplied.
smoothness.planar_accel_and_jerk: world_accel/jerk differentiate sampled world velocity v*[cos(yaw),sin(yaw)] and report vector norms; these include turning/centripetal effects. body_v acceleration/jerk describe longitudinal speed only; body_w describes rotation.
smoothness.jerk: Second finite difference of velocity using interval-midpoint timestamps; all three samples must be in phase. For command channels, this is second command derivative, not executed mechanical jerk.
smoothness.bandwidth_caveat: Unfiltered 20 Hz sampled traces, Nyquist 10 Hz; differentiation amplifies noise and P95/max depend on sample rate and any preprocessing. No claim about unobserved continuous-time maxima or hardware comfort.
smoothness.normalization_caveat: TV depends on duration. Compare both TV/time and equal-route trials; each method can have a different completion time.

lag.reference: reference target angular velocity = manifest.controller.speed * interpolated path curvature at state timestamp t. Also export body_v*k as a separate kinematic diagnostic.
lag.definition: For each lag L in [-1,+1] s at 0.05 s steps, Pearson correlation(reference(t), response(t+L)); response uses its own physical timestamp and linear interpolation within observed support only. Per-lag demeaning and variance normalization.
lag.positive_lag: Response trails the curvature reference. Negative lag indicates anticipatory association.
lag.eligibility: At least 3 pairs and at least 70% of reference-phase samples must overlap. No interpolation across a detected sampling gap.
lag.reliable_heuristic: At least 30 pairs; reference/response SD each >=0.01 rad/s; peak corr >=0.6; optimum not on window boundary; connected corr>=peak-0.05 width <=0.75 s. Thresholds are analysis diagnostics, not calibrated confidence levels.
lag.limitations: Closed-loop association with a path-dependent reference; NOT causal transport-delay identification, NOT material/mechanical hysteresis and NOT proof of model validity. Low-excitation phases can be unidentifiable. Selected maxima are optimistic descriptive statistics.

model_reproduction.definition: Replay the same synthetic Plant with saved command sequence, saved path initial pose, manifest Config and saved true_plant parameters. Derived smoother, delayed command and body states are explicitly marked reproduced.
model_reproduction.interpretation: Reproduction error checks provenance/timing and data integrity only. It is NOT independent predictive validation, hardware parameter estimation or real FAST-LIO/NDT data.

statistics.unit: One completed or failed trial is the experimental unit. Never treat correlated time samples as independent replicates.
statistics.scenario_groups: 3 seeded repeats per scenario/condition/method; historical route has 1 repeat per method. Mean, SD, min and max are descriptive.
statistics.aggregate: 9 trials = 3 fixed scenarios x 3 reused noise seeds, not 9 IID route samples. Fixed-scenario pooled summaries are descriptive.
statistics.pairing: full-native matched on dataset, scenario, condition and noise seed; report failures and undefined metrics without replacing them by zero.
statistics.failures: Incomplete trials retain observed partial-horizon metrics with completion/failure/coverage fields. Such metrics do not establish successful route tracking and should not be compared as if every trial completed.
statistics.small_n: No confidence intervals are reported: n=3 is too small for dependable coverage and scenarios are fixed. No population-wide significance claim.
statistics.signflip: Optional exploratory two-sided exact signflip diagnostic, flipping entire seed blocks together across scenarios. At 3 blocks the smallest attainable two-sided p is 0.25. Symmetry/exchangeability is not established; this is not a confirmatory test.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment over ALL signflip diagnostics in paired_summary.csv; family size is explicit. Native implementation UB/nonrepeatability threats are documented in the manuscript.

missingness: Empty CSV cells and JSON null mean undefined/missing. Infinity clearance means no obstacles, is exported blank with not_applicable_no_obstacles status; it is not a numeric measurement. Expected missing NPZ/failed trials remain in per-trial output.

outputs.trial_metrics.csv: Wide trial x phase metrics, including all failures and missing observations.
outputs.samples/*.csv: All original raw time samples and explicitly named derived quantities; no decimation.
outputs.phase_lags.csv: Lag diagnostics per trial x phase x response; unreliable cases retained.
outputs.lag_curves.csv: Full normalized correlation scan over prescribed lag window.
outputs.model_parameters.csv: Assumed synthetic true plant and controller prediction parameters for every trial.
outputs.path_profiles.csv: All stored reference path points, arc lengths, curvature and curvature gradients, once per dataset/scenario; no smoothing or decimation.
outputs.grouped_metrics.csv: Long descriptive group table with metric, mean, SD, minimum, maximum and valid trial count.
outputs.paired_summary.csv: Matched group descriptive effect sizes and exploratory seed-block diagnostics.
outputs.provenance.json: Input checksums, source checksums, inventory and missingness counts.
